description: This file defines a factory class for creating versioned payload builders for webhooks, including interfaces for specific payload types and mappings from webhook trigger events to builder categories.

classes.name: PayloadBuilderFactory
classes.description: Factory class that manages versioned sets of webhook payload builders, providing type-safe retrieval based on trigger events and version.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the factory with a default version and builder set, and registers it.

methods.name: registerVersion
methods.description: Registers a new set of payload builders for a specific webhook version.

methods.name: getBuilderSet
methods.description: Retrieves the payload builder set for a given version, falling back to default if not registered.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Overloaded method that returns a type-safe payload builder based on version and trigger event.

methods.name: getRegisteredVersions
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered webhook versions.

methods.name: isVersionSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific webhook version is supported.

methods.name: getDefaultVersion
methods.description: Returns the default webhook version used as fallback.

search-terms: trigger event to builder category mapping
